title: One script runs the whole release check and prints one verdict per PR, so a missing line reads as FAIL
why: Coordinator incident, 04:06 CST Nov 10: it released #2515 to runner 8 while `merge --reviewed` listed it under "No record". Its grep for "^#2515 " printed nothing, and it read the silence as fine. The harm: an unreviewed PR reaches a batch.
note: Fix: one script runs every release check: the `merge --reviewed` line is present and done, the record is unedited, the lint verdict, merge-tree, and the stack bases. It prints PASS or FAIL per PR, and a missing line is FAIL. Step release-pairwise-clash (the pairwise merge-tree check) can become one of its checks. Coordinator started lane session_013NEJKyjEhPeuaT1HrHD16Y at 04:53 CST Nov 10. #2539 released to the batch ( CST Nov 10, coordinator); round-3 low notes are note release-check-low-notes.
